2.4.4.title: Balanced tab bar
notes: The + button is back in the middle: Home, Activity, Balances on the left; Personal, Prayer, More on the right.
More (bills, meals, list, insights, settings) moved from the top bar to the tab bar, so long home names fit at the top.

2.4.3.title: Sweeter azan voices
notes: The azan is now Omar Hisham Al Arabi, and Fajr is Mishary Rashid Alafasy (with “As-salatu khayrun min an-nawm”). Silence trimmed, volume levelled.
They download to your phone once when you are signed in (about 9 MB), then play offline. Until then the built-in azan plays.
Prefer another? Built-in or your own file are one tap away in the Prayer tab under Sound.

2.4.2.title: Your own azan, cleaned up
notes: Pick your favourite azan recording in the Prayer tab (one for Fajr, one for the rest): silence at the start and end is cut, long gaps shortened and the volume raised automatically.
The tab bar fits the + button again, and messages show at the top.

2.4.1.title: Tidier tab bar
notes: The + button fits the tab bar again now that Prayer has its own tab, on small phones too.
Messages like “Saved” or “Azan is on” now show at the top, under the header, instead of over the tab bar.

2.4.0.title: Azan five times a day
notes: New Prayer tab: today's prayer times, the next prayer with a countdown, and the Hijri date. Sehri and Iftar times in Ramadan.
Auto azan, on by default: plays at Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib and Isha by itself, with the app closed and the screen off. Jumu'ah on Fridays.
Fajr plays its own azan, with “As-salatu khayrun min an-nawm”.
Plays loud through the alarm speaker (even on silent), or through your Bluetooth speaker or headphones when connected. Stop from the notification or with a volume button.
Times follow your phone's time zone, or pick your city (all of Bangladesh's big towns) or use your location. Method and Asr (Hanafi) are set for your country; adjust minutes to match your mosque.
Per prayer: azan, notification only, or off. Reminders before each prayer and at sunrise. Your own azan recording if you like.
“Make sure it plays” checks battery saver, notifications and your phone maker's auto-start setting, with one tap to fix each, plus a 1-minute test with the app closed.

2.3.0.title: Updates install themselves
notes: No more downloading and reinstalling: new versions now arrive inside the app (about 1 MB) and start the next time you open it.
Safe by design: each update is checked before it's used, and if one ever fails to start, the app goes back to the version that worked.
Settings shows when an update is ready, with Restart now if you can't wait.
Your data, sign-in and settings stay exactly as they are.

2.2.0.title: Profiles, and invites that know who you are
notes: Your profile: add your name and a photo (tap your picture on the first screen). Your photo shows on you in every home and trip.
Invite one person at a time: each person gets their own link. Opening it joins as them, no more picking your name from a list.
Send an invite by email right from the app. Signing in with that address sets them up as the right person.
New phone? Sign in and the app already knows who you are in each group.
People in settings show who has joined, who is invited, and their email.
Made with ☕ by Ehsan.

2.1.0.title: Personal spending, safer adding, a smarter to-buy list
notes: Personal tab: your own expenses, private to you. Your total includes your share of the home.
Check before saving: see the amount, who paid, each share and who owes whom before anything is added.
Amounts fill themselves in: type what some people owe or paid, the rest is shared equally.
To-buy list: tap “I'll buy” or assign someone, mark urgent or needed by a day. The buyer gets a reminder.
Updates bell and a dashboard: what others changed, what needs you, what you spent this month.
Reminders on your phone for bills, tonight's meals and things you're buying.
Tap any expense for its full split and history, or a person for their statement.
More filters in Activity. Bills, meals, list and settings are now under the grid icon at the top.
